cards.card_text: Then David says, "May my vindication come from Your presence; may Your eyes see what is right." Not the neighbors, not the comment section, not the guy at work with OPINIONS: David wants the LORD's eyes on this one.
cards.verse_text: May my vindication come from Your presence; may Your eyes see what is right.
cards.snippet: May my vindication come from Your presence; may Your eyes see what is right.

cards.card_text: Blessing and vindication from God Riches and a long life Land and a strong kingdom
cards.verse_text: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.
cards.snippet: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.

cards.card_text: True or false: David wants the people who favor his vindication to shout for joy and gladness.
cards.verse_text: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”

cards.card_text: Where does the LORD say the vindication of the servants of the LORD comes from?
cards.verse_text: This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their vindication is from Me,” declares the LORD.
cards.snippet: This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their vindication is from Me,” declares the LORD.

cards.card_text: The One from Edom answers for Himself: He is proclaiming vindication.
cards.verse_text: “It is I, proclaiming vindication, mighty to save.”
cards.snippet: “It is I, proclaiming vindication, mighty to save.”

cards.card_text: Then comes a call: the LORD has brought forth our vindication, so come, let's tell it in Zion.
cards.verse_text: “The LORD has brought forth our vindication; come, let us tell in Zion what the LORD our God has accomplished.”

cards.card_text: And the text says those autumn rains are given for their vindication.
cards.verse_text: Be glad, O children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God, for He has given you the autumn rains for your vindication.
cards.snippet: …your God, for He has given you the autumn rains for your vindication.

cards.card_text: Paul says look at what this godly sorrow has produced in them: earnestness, eagerness to clear themselves, indignation, alarm, longing, zeal, vindication!
cards.verse_text: Consider what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what zeal, what vindication!
cards.snippet: …to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what zeal, what vindication!
